admission.justification: No member alone delivers the promise: agent-alone navigation without the display gate can acknowledge a missing screen, the gate without truthful deadline naming can wait silently, and naming without navigation reaches nothing. Together they promise the selected chat appears or its problem is named.

guarantee: For an open-capable channel, the selected document agent is opened by native agent-only navigation with no extra frame or unsupported workspace hop. shown requires exact host-workspace route, stored focused pane, no contradicting visible tab and mounted nonloading chat. Negotiated on-chat releases input after identity holds while waiting for drawing; negotiated native load-failed ends the dashboard wait and leaves only the application's own failure/Retry. A responsive late answer stays a named wait, not a failure or automatic load. Missing post-onLoad ready or open answer is probed: unanswered open-request ping names the unsettled agent and permits one fallback if its URL is not already loaded, while unanswered post-load ping or the 45 s cold-load cap settles unavailable without reloading, names whether the frame already named the agent or stayed open, keeps a waiting notice with Retry for unconfirmed URL loads, and continues accepting late ready/pong. Explicit unsupported-open capability uses each agent URL with its notice. The pane shows the application's actual screen, not an indefinitely preserved earlier picture.
title: The selected document's agent chat appears, or the pane names its problem
